regions.merged_text: You and your community. Yes we quite enjoyed our visit to Portland and out to your ideally located Mother house in Marylhurst - on our way to San Francisco and Los Angeles. .We are sending in separate cover book- lets pertaining to wonderful source of blessings, the Seraphic Mass Association. I am enrolling your dear Mother too in the Emergence list for the intention that she speedily improve in health - physically, mentally, spiritually. I hope she give the doctors a surprise.
